description: This file defines the PersistenceStatusStage class, which creates a graph stage in an Akka Streams pipeline to retrieve and aggregate persistence health metrics from multiple instances, publishing health check requests, collecting responses, and determining overall health status in either outlet 0 or 1.

classes.name: PersistenceStatusStage
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create an Akka Streams graph stage for retrieving persistence health metrics, coordinating responses from multiple instances, and aggregating the results into a CreditDecision.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Akka Streams graph stage that, upon receiving an integer input (expected number of reports), publishes health request messages, waits for responses, and outputs either aggregated status information or credit rejection decision based on the responses.

methods.name: askAggregator
methods.description: Sets up an actor to collect a specified number of responses from instances, sends a retrieve health message, and returns a future that completes with the actor's reply.

methods.name: askAggregatorFlow
methods.description: Constructs an Akka Stream Flow that asynchronously asks for the expected number of responses and pairs the result with the expected count.

methods.name: checkAggregatorReply
methods.description: Evaluates the responses received from the aggregator actor, verifying whether the number of StatusInfo responses matches expectations, returning either a positive or negative CreditDecision.

methods.name: safeCastAsStatusInfoList
methods.description: Safely casts an object to a list of StatusInfo objects if possible, returning an Optional containing the list or empty if casting is not possible.
